item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover southern China. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will fall over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Bright periods during the day. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
